entity: US doctors paid $10K+ by drug companies vs prescribing cost per claim and brand-name share, 2024
what_we_add: The 2024 numbers: 1.2-5.6x cost per claim at $10K+, brand share rising in all 7 specialties, internal medicine $94 to $355
why: ProPublica and PLOS One state the same finding, same direction: more industry money, more brand-name prescribing and higher cost per patient, dose-response across specialties. Their data is 2014-15; nobody states our 2024 multipliers. NBER's generic-transition result is a different measure, not a contradiction.
